description: Add a link, affiliate link, discount code, section title (kind header, title only) or download (kind file with media_id) to the bio page. Links get a counted short link (/go/…). A download hands visitors a file, after asking for their email when gate is email (audience_list keeps who left one). Amazon links never get a short link: Amazon's terms forbid redirecting them, so they're shared as-is and counted only from the bio page. Say when a code ends in words with ends ("end of November", "2 weeks") and repeat ends_local back.

after_end.description: Once it ends: hide (default) takes it off the page; show keeps it grayed out as ended for 14 days; shop keeps it as a plain shop link without the code

auto_apply.description: The short link applies the code at the store's checkout (store.com/discount/CODE), so visitors have nothing to type; the code stays shown as a backup. Shopify stores only: on any other site the link would not open. Needs a code

button.description: kind signup: the words on its button. Default "Send it"

code.description: Discount code people tap to copy on the bio page

email_list.description: kind file, with gate email: visitors may also agree to get your emails, and the page says so (audience_list opted_in). Default false

ends.description: Or when it ends in words, on the workspace's clock: "Nov 30", "11/30", "end of November", "Sunday", "2 weeks", "48 hours". A day ends at 11:59 pm

ends_at.description: Leaves the bio page after this (see after_end); null for no end

featured.description: Show it as a bigger card, with image_media_id across the top

gate.description: kind file: email asks visitors for their email first; the file opens at once and a copy is mailed. They're added to audience_list. null (default) opens it with no question

gift_link_id.description: kind signup: a download (links_list kind file) on this page that is mailed to people after they sign up. null for none

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

image_media_id.description: A ready photo from media_list, shown beside the title (or across a featured card)

image_url.description: Or a picture at a public https address: it's copied into media and shows once ready

kind.description: offer for a discount code, affiliate for commission links, header for a section title (title only), file for a download (media_id), signup for an email signup (title, button, gift_link_id, welcome); guessed when left out

media_id.description: kind file: the file visitors download (a PDF, ZIP, photo, video or audio from media_list, or uploaded with media_upload_url). Its name titles the block when title is left out

note.description: Small print under the title, e.g. 'Ends Sunday'

on_bio.description: Show it on the bio page

percent_off.description: What the code takes off, in percent: the bio page says "20% off" beside the code. Set it whenever the code's percent is known

picture_from_page.description: Copy the picture its own page shows (og:image) into media, once; it's never refreshed. On by default (a logo first, else the page picture). Not for Amazon links

pinned.description: Keep its place: tests and tuning never move it

position.description: top, bottom (the default), { after: link_id }, or { under_section: link_id of a section title } for right under that title

remind_days.description: A push this many days before it ends; null is off. Codes start at 2

slug.description: Short link name; made from the title when left out

starts_at.description: Stays off the bio page until this (its short link works already); null for no start

title.description: Left out: the link's own page names it (filled_from_page). Required for kind header

url.description: Where it goes; https is added if missing. Required except for kind header

welcome.description: kind signup: send a welcome email after signup (with the gift's link when gift_link_id is set). Default false

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: link_create
title: Add a link or code
